items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Lady Day and I were in the booth drinking.

ctx.x: So one night. Roy Eldridge and Charlie Shavers were on the bandstand at the Three Deuces jamming, and Charlie was blowing Roy off the bandstand, you know. So Ben comes in and

a white Rolls, went around in a white Rolls, Lady Day and Charlie and I were in the booth drinking. Now Charlie is sitting up against the wall in the booth by his self. And Lady Day and I are sitting over together facing Charlie. And we're facing the door and the meanwhile, Charlie's back is turn to the door.

Say oh my God, here comes Ben, he's staggering in, he can smell the bottle, he ain't had no drink, he just smell one and he's drunk. Say watch your drinks. He comes over to the table and leans over. There's my drink, Billie's drink and rakes them off and Charlie's drink and rakes them off in Charlie's lap. Well you know, naturally Charlie's reaction would be to jump up, you know, to keep them from drowning, off of -- in a hurry.
